entry_surfaces./: split hero — brand positioning, live unified search (colleges, courses, exams), real stats on left, quick stream badge pill selector & featured top institute grid on right
entry_surfaces./colleges: structured directory with sticky filter sidebar (stream, city, state, college type, fee range), top search & sorting bar, and high-density college cards with fees, cutoff, ratings, and instant enquiry CTA
entry_surfaces./colleges/:slug: editorial college profile header with cover image, NIRF ranking, badges, quick action row, tabbed sub-navigation (Overview, Courses & Fees, Admission 2026, Cutoff, Placements, Reviews), and lead capture panel
entry_surfaces./courses: stream-categorized course hub with degree level filters (UG, PG, Diploma, Doctorate), duration, average fee bracket, career opportunities, and direct college list for each course
entry_surfaces./exams: national & state entrance exam timeline tracker (JEE, NEET, CAT, GATE, MHT-CET, etc.) with exam dates, syllabus, eligibility, and accepting colleges
entry_surfaces./compare: side-by-side 3-college matrix comparing NIRF rank, fee structures, placement CTC (highest & avg), admission criteria, and facilities
entry_surfaces./news: education updates, admission notices, cutoff analysis, and expert career guidance articles with category filters and search
entry_surfaces./news/:slug: article reader view with table of contents, author/consultant byline, share tools, related colleges and inline free counselling enquiry form
entry_surfaces./consultation: guided counselling booking workflow with student profile questionnaire, preferred location, budget, target course, and instant WhatsApp callback hook
entry_surfaces./admin: password-protected portal dashboard with lead management (filtering, export to CSV, status tracking: New, Contacted, In-Progress, Converted) and content CRUD for colleges, courses, exams, and articles

accessibility_requirements.data_testid_convention: All interactive inputs, buttons, filter chips, tabs, search bars, and table rows must have explicit kebab-case data-testid attributes (e.g. data-testid='hero-search-input', data-testid='enquire-now-button', data-testid='filter-stream-engineering', data-testid='compare-checkbox-iit-bombay', data-testid='admin-leads-table').

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Scope Boundaries: We focus 100% on INDIA higher education only (No Work Abroad, No Study Abroad as requested).

2. Logo & Branding: Use https://www.digitalshiksha.in/wp-content/uploads/2026/02/Digital-Shiksha-Logo-1.png in Navbar and Footer. Incorporate the red 'Digital', deep navy 'Shiksha', teal graduation cap motif, and counselling/admission badge styling.
3. Typography: Implement the Apple website font stack in index.css: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Display', 'SF Pro Text', 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif.
4. Contact & Address: Saudamini Commercial Complex, C1-203, Paud Road, Bhusari Colony, Kothrud, Pune, Maharashtra 411038 | Phone: +91 8149 68 9468 | Email: enquiry@digitalshiksha.in.

5. Key Academic Streams: Engineering (B.Tech, M.Tech), Management (MBA, PGDM, BBA), Medical (MBBS, BDS, BAMS), Science (B.Sc, M.Sc), Commerce & Banking (B.Com, CA), Computer Applications (BCA, MCA), Law (BA LLB, LLM), Design & Animation.

6. Key Features: Unified Search, Stream Discovery, College Directory with multi-facet filters, Rich College Detail page with tabs (Overview, Courses & Fees, Admission 2026, Cutoffs, Placements), Courses directory, Entrance Exams portal, 3-way College Comparison, Educational News/Articles, and floating WhatsApp/Call widgets.

7. Backend & DB: MongoDB collections for colleges, courses, exams, articles, and enquiries/leads. Create seed.py with rich data for top Indian institutes (IIT Bombay, IIM Ahmedabad, AIIMS New Delhi, COEP Pune, Symbiosis Pune, BITS Pilani, etc.).
8. Admin Panel: Secure admin route (/admin) protected with password (e.g. admin123) with full lead table and CRUD capability.
9. Testing Compliance: Ensure data-testid attributes on all key interactive elements.
